identificationModule.briefTitle: FAC Versus FAC Plus Weekly Paclitaxel as Adjuvant Treatment of Node Negative High Risk Breast Cancer Patients
identificationModule.officialTitle: Multicenter Randomized Phase III Trial to Compare 6 FAC Cycles vs 4 FAC Cycles Followed by 8 Weekly Paclitaxel Administrations, as Adjuvant Treatment for Node Negative Operable Breast Cancer Patients

armGroups.label: Arm A: FAC
armGroups.description: FAC X 6 The standard arm consisted of six cycles of FAC (fluorouracil 500 mg/m2, doxorubicin 50mg/m2, and cyclophosphamide 500mg/m2) administered once every 3 weeks.

armGroups.label: Arm B: FAC-wP
armGroups.description: FAC X 4 + 8 weekly Paclitaxel (wP) Patients in the experimental arm received four cycles of the FAC regimen followed by eight weekly administrations of paclitaxel (100mg/m2 per dose)
